summary: Kimball Electronics (KE) filed an 8-K to report its acquisition of Helvoet Polymer Technologies B.V. and Helvoet Rubber Plastics Technologies (India) Pvt. Ltd. from Hydratec Industries N.V. The all-cash purchase price was approximately €90 million (~$103 million), subject to post-closing working capital adjustments. Approximately €1.8 million of the cash consideration is held in escrow as security. The deal closed on July 1, 2026, funded by cash and existing credit lines. The agreement includes customary representations, warranties, and indemnification provisions. No board recommendation, advisor names, or premium percentage were disclosed. Watch for post-closing adjustments and integration updates.
